_comment: HORUS v3.15: ONE confirmatory test of a v3.14 candidate that finals_preregistration_v3_14.json declared 'reported, never eligible' (config A, utility-only rule) and that passed H1 on the v3.14 selection seeds. Registered BEFORE any held-out run of v3.14 or v3.15 (no seed in 2200..2259 or 2300..2359 has been simulated). The candidate is used exactly as it exists (no retraining, no config change). The H1/H2 rules, arms, guardrails, statistics, objective and gate are reused UNCHANGED from finals_preregistration_v3.json. finals_preregistration_v3_14.json stays in force for its own confirmatory run (v3.14.24 on 2200..2259). Nothing below may change after the candidate has been evaluated on 2300..2359.

basis.candidate_origin: v3.14 step 3 (twin.run_v314 derive): weights v3.14.10 (clean FedAvg of the pre-registered v3.14 federation) + decision config A (utility_only, switch_margin 0.1) = v3.14.32. Config A and its version number were fixed in finals_preregistration_v3_14.json before any v3.14 candidate existed.

selection_seed_result.H2_failure: HO-rate guardrail vs cho_global/cho_global_ext/cho_mse (per-cell increases in mobile cells); by design the utility-only rule trades extra handovers for spectral efficiency

basis.fedavg_vs_median: v3.14.32 (FedAvg, pooled selection utility 12.1251) over v3.14.33 (median, 12.1231) by the v3.14 step-6 tie rule (higher pooled selection utility), the rule already registered

seeds.held_out_eval: 2300..2359 (60 per cell, 720 paired episodes; never used by anything)
seeds.used_before_this_file: everything listed in finals_preregistration_v3_14.json plus 1300..1302 and 1500..1539; 2200..2259 are reserved for the v3.14 confirmatory run

confirmatory.run: Exactly one: python -m twin.evaluate_v3 --v3 v3.14.32 --seed0 2300 --seeds 60 --workers 15 --final --prereg pipeline/finals_preregistration_v3_15.json (writes working/evidence/finals-v3.15/final/ and working/evidence/finals-results-v3.15.json)
confirmatory.rules: go_no_go H1_oracle and H2_deployable exactly as in finals_preregistration_v3.json, applied to v3.14.32.
confirmatory.headline: H1 pass -> 'federated HORUS beats per-situation best-tuned A3 and CHO (incl. the oracle over HORUS's own action space)'. H1 fail -> no oracle claim from this file; H2 is reported as observed (expected to fail on the HO guardrail).
confirmatory.no_rerun: No rerun, no substitute candidate, no threshold change, whatever the result.

multiplicity: Two pre-registered confirmatory tests exist after this file: v3.14 (v3.14.24, 2200..2259) and v3.15 (v3.14.32, 2300..2359), different candidates and disjoint seeds, each at the unchanged 0.05 level; both are reported whatever their outcome. In addition (reported, does not change any headline) each file's H1/H2 utility comparisons are re-checked at 97.5% (Bonferroni over the two files) by working/evidence/v3.15/bonferroni.py, committed with this file.
order: Both files are registered before either held-out run. Run order: the v3.14 confirmatory run, then this one.
